name: Sin-Kung Logistics Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sin-Kung Logistics Berhad 与 Penang Development Corporation 及 Airport Authority Hong Kong 签订的谅解备忘录均无重大进展；与 PDC 的谅解备忘录已于2026年2月11日到期，但公司表示该备忘录目前仍然有效，PILA 项目的动工仪式及启动仪式已延期。公司未公告任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。
overview_en: In 2026, Sin-Kung Logistics Berhad's memoranda of understanding with Penang Development Corporation and Airport Authority Hong Kong saw no material development; the MOU with PDC expired on 11 February 2026 but the company said it remains valid as of to date, and the groundbreaking ceremony and launch of PILA have been postponed. The company did not announce any expansion, reduction, disposal or new contract for any business segment.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司与 PDC 及 Airport Authority Hong Kong 的谅解备忘录今年均无重大进展，PILA 项目动工及启动仪式延期。
segments.note_en: The company's MOUs with PDC and Airport Authority Hong Kong saw no material development this year, and the groundbreaking and launch of PILA have been postponed.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Airport Authority Hong Kong 的谅解备忘录无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There is no material development on the MOU with Airport Authority Hong Kong.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Penang Development Corporation 的谅解备忘录无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There is no material development on the MOU with Penang Development Corporation.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Penang Development Corporation 的谅解备忘录项下拟议区域位于 PILA 项目范围内，谅解备忘录活动的正式启动及后续最终协议的谈判与签署取决于 PILA 的正式启动与进展，关键运营步骤将推迟至当局修订 PILA 启动时间表之后。
actions.text_en: The Proposed Area under the MOU with Penang Development Corporation is situated within the PILA project development;

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Penang Development Corporation 的谅解备忘录已于2026年2月11日到期，但公司表示该备忘录目前仍然有效；原定2026年9月5日举行的 Penang International Logistics Aeropark (PILA) 动工仪式及启动仪式已延期。
actions.text_en: The MOU with Penang Development Corporation expired on 11 February 2026, but the company said it remains valid as of to date;

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Airport Authority Hong Kong 的谅解备忘录无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There is no material development on the MOU with Airport Authority Hong Kong.
